expected.attribute_definition: The official legal status of each kind of restricted area defines the kind of restriction(s), for example the restriction for a 'game reserve' may be 'entering prohibited'.

global_listed_values.label: Offshore Safety Zone
global_listed_values.definition: The area around an offshore installation within which vessels are prohibited from entering without permission. Special regulations protect installations within a safety zone and vessels of all nationalities are required to respect the zone.

global_listed_values.label: Nature Reserve
global_listed_values.definition: A tract of land or water managed so as to preserve its flora, fauna, physical features, etc.

global_listed_values.label: Bird Sanctuary
global_listed_values.definition: A place where birds are bred and protected.

global_listed_values.label: Game Reserve
global_listed_values.definition: A place where wild animals or birds hunted for sport or food are kept undisturbed for private use.

global_listed_values.label: Seal Sanctuary
global_listed_values.definition: A place where seals are protected.

global_listed_values.label: Degaussing Range
global_listed_values.definition: An area, usually about two cables diameter, within which ships' magnetic fields may be measured; sensing instruments and cables are installed on the seabed in the range and there are cables leading from the range to a control position ashore.

global_listed_values.label: Military Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area controlled by the military in which restrictions may apply.

global_listed_values.label: Historic Wreck Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area around certain wrecks of historical importance to protect the wrecks from unauthorized interference by diving, salvage or deposition (including anchoring).

global_listed_values.label: Navigational Aid Safety Zone
global_listed_values.definition: An area around a navigational aid which vessels are prohibited from entering.

global_listed_values.label: Minefield
global_listed_values.definition: An area laid and maintained with explosive mines for defence or practice purposes.

global_listed_values.label: Swimming Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area in which people may swim and therefore vessel movement may be restricted.

global_listed_values.label: Waiting Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area reserved for vessels waiting to enter a harbour.

global_listed_values.label: Research Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area where marine research takes place.

global_listed_values.label: Dredging Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area where dredging is taking place.

global_listed_values.label: Fish Sanctuary
global_listed_values.definition: A place where fish (including shellfish and crustaceans) are protected.

global_listed_values.label: Ecological Reserve
global_listed_values.definition: A tract of land or water managed so as to preserve the relation of plants and living creatures to each other and to their surroundings.

global_listed_values.label: No Wake Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area in which a vessels' speed must be reduced in order to reduce the size of the wake it produces.

global_listed_values.label: Swinging Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area where vessels turn.

global_listed_values.label: Environmentally Sensitive Sea Area
global_listed_values.definition: A generic term which may be used to describe a wide range of areas, considered sensitive for a variety of environmental reasons.

global_listed_values.label: Particularly Sensitive Sea Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area that needs special protection through action by IMO because of its significance for regional ecological, socio-economic or scientific reasons and because it may be vulnerable to damage by international shipping activities.

global_listed_values.label: Disengagement Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area near a fairway where vessels can go to clear the way or make an about turn and possibly return to a waiting area when nautical conditions impose it.

global_listed_values.label: Port Security Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area in which defence, law and treaty enforcement, and counter-terrorism activities that fall within the port and maritime domain apply.

global_listed_values.label: Coral Sanctuary
global_listed_values.definition: A place where coral is protected.

global_listed_values.label: Recreation Area
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which recreational activities regularly take place and therefore vessel movement may be restricted.

expected.attribute_definition: The official legal statute of each kind of restricted area.

global_listed_values.label: Anchoring Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which anchoring is not permitted.

global_listed_values.label: Anchoring Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which anchoring is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

global_listed_values.label: Fishing Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which fishing is not permitted.

global_listed_values.label: Fishing Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which fishing is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

global_listed_values.label: Trawling Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which trawling is not permitted.

global_listed_values.label: Trawling Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which trawling is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

global_listed_values.label: Entry Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which navigation and/or anchoring is prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Entry Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which navigation is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

global_listed_values.label: Dredging Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which dredging is not permitted.

global_listed_values.label: Dredging Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which dredging is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

global_listed_values.label: Diving Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which diving is not permitted.

global_listed_values.label: Diving Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which diving is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

global_listed_values.label: No Wake
global_listed_values.definition: Mariners must adjust the speed of their vessels to reduce the wave or wash which may cause erosion or disturb moored vessels.

global_listed_values.label: Area To Be Avoided
global_listed_values.definition: An IMO declared routeing measure comprising an area within defined limits in which either navigation is particularly hazardous or it is exceptionally important to avoid casualties and which should be avoided by all ships, or certain classes of ships.

global_listed_values.label: Construction Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: The erection of permanent or temporary fixed structures or artificial islands is prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Discharging Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which discharging or dumping is prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Discharging Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: A specified area designated by an appropriate authority, within which discharging or dumping is restricted in accordance with specified conditions.

global_listed_values.label: Industrial or Mineral Exploration/Development Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which industrial or mineral exploration and development are prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Industrial or Mineral Exploration/Development Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: A specified area designated by an appropriate authority, within which industrial or mineral exploration and development is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

global_listed_values.label: Drilling Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which excavating a hole on the seabed with a drill is prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Drilling Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: A specified area designated by an appropriate authority, within which excavating a hole on the seabed with a drill is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

global_listed_values.label: Removal of Historical Artefacts Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which the removal of historical artefacts is prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Cargo Transhipment (Lightening) Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area in which cargo transhipment (lightening) is prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Dragging Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area in which the dragging of anything along the seabed, for example bottom trawling, is prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Stopping Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area in which a vessel is prohibited from stopping.

global_listed_values.label: Landing Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area in which landing is prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Speed Restricted
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which speed is restricted.

global_listed_values.label: Swimming Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area in which swimming is prohibited.

global_listed_values.label: Power-Driven Vessels Prohibited
global_listed_values.definition: An area within which any vessel propelled by machinery is prohibited.
